name: run-advanced-tests
description: Run cargo-cicd tests with the advanced feature flag enabled
help: Execute the cargo-cicd test suite with advanced features (ignore, rayon, blake3, tracing, miette, etc.) enabled. Supports running all tests, library tests only, integration tests, or specific named tests.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which tests to run: 'all' (everything), 'lib' (library unit tests), 'integration' (integration tests only), or a specific test name (e.g., 'invariants', 'cli', 'feature_projection')

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Build and run tests in release mode for performance testing (slower build, faster test execution)

parameters.name: nocapture
parameters.description: Show all output from tests, including println! and eprintln! statements

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: Number of test threads to use (e.g., '1' for single-threaded, '4' for 4 threads, or leave empty for default)

parameters.name: show-summary
parameters.description: Display a summary report at the end showing pass/fail counts and execution time

scripts.name: build_cargo_args
scripts.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Build the cargo test command with appropriate flags

# Start with base command
CARGO_CMD="cargo test"

# Add features flag (always required for advanced)
CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD --features advanced"

# Add scope (test selection)
SCOPE="{{scope}}"
case "$SCOPE" in
  lib)
    CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD --lib"
    ;;
  integration)
    CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD --test '*'"
    ;;
  all)
    # no filter, run everything
    ;;
  "")
    # Default to all
    ;;
  *)
    # Specific test name - use --test flag
    CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD --test $SCOPE"
    ;;
esac

# Add release flag if requested
{% if release %}CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD --release"{% endif %}

# Add nocapture if requested
{% if nocapture %}CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD -- --nocapture"{% endif %}

# Add thread count if specified
{% if threads and threads != "" %}CARGO_CMD="$CARGO_CMD -- --test-threads={{threads}}"{% endif %}

echo "$CARGO_CMD"

scripts.name: run_tests
scripts.content:
#!/bin/bash
set -o pipefail

# Build the command
CARGO_CMD=$(bash -c "$BUILD_CMD")

echo "[run-advanced-tests] Running: $CARGO_CMD"
echo "[run-advanced-tests] Advanced features enabled: ignore, rayon, blake3, tracing, miette, moka, petgraph, etc."
echo "---"

# Run tests and capture output
TEST_OUTPUT=$(mktemp)
TEST_STATUS=0

if eval "$CARGO_CMD" 2>&1 | tee "$TEST_OUTPUT"; then
  TEST_STATUS=0
else
  TEST_STATUS=$?
fi

# Parse results if summary requested
{% if show_summary %}
echo ""
echo "---"
echo "[run-advanced-tests] Test Summary:"

# Extract test counts from output
PASSED=$(grep -c "test.*ok" "$TEST_OUTPUT" || echo "0")
FAILED=$(grep -c "test.*FAILED" "$TEST_OUTPUT" || echo "0")

if [ "$TEST_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Status: ✓ ALL TESTS PASSED"
else
  echo "Status: ✗ SOME TESTS FAILED"
fi

echo "Exit code: $TEST_STATUS"
echo ""

# Show failures if any
if [ "$FAILED" -gt 0 ] || [ "$TEST_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[run-advanced-tests] Failures detected:"
  grep -A 5 "test.*FAILED" "$TEST_OUTPUT" || grep -A 10 "error\[" "$TEST_OUTPUT" || echo "(Details in output above)"
fi
{% endif %}

rm -f "$TEST_OUTPUT"
exit $TEST_STATUS

notes: The 'advanced' feature gate includes: ignore, rayon, blake3, tracing, tracing-subscriber, miette, thiserror, moka, bitcode, petgraph, jiff, hdrhistogram, aho-corasick

Available named tests: invariants, cli, cicd_toml_truth, autonomic_policies, changed_tests, git_phase_closure, feature_projection, wasm4pm_harness, wasm4pm_evidence_gate, wasm4pm_evidence_mutation, wasm4pm_refusal_cases, ggen_customization_guard, refusal_calibration, lsp_explain
Use 'scope: invariants' to run just the 7 public boundary invariants tests
Use 'nocapture: true' to see all println!/eprintln! output from tests
Use 'threads: 1' to run tests serially (useful for debugging flaky tests)
Use 'release: true' for performance-sensitive testing (slower compile, faster execution)
The skill adds RUST_BACKTRACE=1 automatically for better error diagnostics
